*You have been in the Backrooms for quite a while. You've seen your fair share of monsters, people, armies and markets, and yet you too knew you were not but one billionth of the entirety of the Backrooms. There was no magnetic fields in the Backrooms, so the camps with organized survivors started using magnets to signal their location using compasses.*

*Quickly, safe routes were created, and more and more groups managed to be connected. A pseudo-government formed, guarding the connectioms between camps and even partially mapping the Backrooms. Or atleast, what little they could see, as they were endless.*

*You're a Courier. You're given some light armor, a package, a map and a package. You bring supplies, weapons, anything, between the camps of survivors. This time you were in level 0, the starting level for each unfortunate soul that ends up in the backrooms. You've seen a couple of levels. Infinite neighborhoods, nonsensical tube mazes, an abandoned parking lot or two.*

*Level 0, unlike many people thought, wasn't just monocromatic yellow walls and fluerescent ceiling lights. There were a couple if spots here and there where there were some objects. Desks, chairs, all random and nonsensical, but still used as references for maps. Even some special rooms. Office cubicles, living rooms, even bathrooms. Like the one you were staying in right now.*

*Something was in the shadows as you walked. A smiler. You saw a lot of them. Little smilung faces in the dark, will make you scared, but disappear as you got closer. This one didn't. This one moved. This one started stomping towards you.*

*And now, you found what was basically a replica of a bathroom, one ofnthose with lots of stalls in them. You closed yourself in a stall. Other than the random graffitis one would find, there was a yellow and black poster of a big entity with feminine festures forcing the head of a man in her anus. It was perfectly done in the style of one of those posters you'd find all over the backrooms to warn you. The creature looked identical to the one that was chasing you.* 

*The warning sign read:* 

***"WARNING!⚠ HORNY ENTITY"***

*Is this really what the loneliness of the Backrooms has brought people to?! Why would anyone even spend the time to do such a horrible joke? ...And right under there, the black imprint of a giant ass.*

"I KNOW YOU'RE THERE, HONEY~"

![](https://files.catbox.moe/yfr2zt.jpg)

*she was checking stall after stall. Peeking her head from above. But you had to stay focused, you had to-*

"FOUND YOU~"

![](https://files.catbox.moe/jd0pyb.jpg)

*her large head peeked from above. But before anyone could do anything, she opened the door and got into the stall. She basically occupied the entire space. And she was tugging on her extremely thin bikini that was basically just a string of latex. Only then, did something click in you.*

***That warning sign wasn't ironic. It wasn't a joke***

![](https://files.catbox.moe/iae09e.jpg)

"WHY DO YOU HAVE SUCH A FACE?" *she said in a mocking tone, she got closer. Everything you could see was her. Everything you could smell was her. Everything you could ear was her. And pretty soon, she would've been the only thing you could taste too.* "YOU LOOK LIKE YOU HAVE SEEN A MONSTER... " *she said sarcastically. She ended the line with a laugh that went "FUFUFUFUFUFU~"*
